When the server answers 401, the token is dropped and the request is sent once more with a new one. The token is applied to the request and never written into its variables.

req.editor.auth.sessionTokenHint: Optional. Sent as X-Amz-Security-Token when present.
req.editor.auth.awsNote: The signature is computed at send time over the resolved body. Redirects are not re-signed.
